IC1: - Diabetic pregnant patients [AND] with type one diabetes [AND] and [NOT] no other chronic disorders
IC2: - Patients on insulin in the 3rd trimester of pregnancy (on insulin therapy since start of gestation)
IC3: - Patients pregnant in single [NOT] living fetus with [NOT] no apparent congenital anomalies
IC4: - Haemoglobin A 1 C (HbA1c) level between 7% to 11%
IC5: - All patients have done a dating ultrasound to confirm gestational age, viability [AND] and rule out any abnormality
